name: Alohi
summary: One secure ecosystem for document workflows: Sign.Plus e-signatures, Fax.Plus online faxing and Scan.Plus scanning — paperwork handled, compliance included.
best_for: businesses that need secure online faxing, e-signatures or scanning — especially regulated ones needing HIPAA-compliant fax on the Enterprise tier
skip_if: you only need occasional e-signatures (a single dedicated tool may be cheaper) or your document volume is low enough for free options
honest_knock: The honest catch is that Alohi is a suite of separate products — Fax.Plus, Sign.Plus, Scan.Plus — each with its own subscription, so "one ecosystem" can mean several line items if you want e-signatures and faxing and scanning. Page and member limits on the lower tiers are modest, and HIPAA/BAA sits only on the top tier. For a single job (say online faxing), it's clean and cheap; for the full workflow, add up the parts.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-10 and re-read unchanged 2026-09-27 on fax.plus/pricing and sign.plus/pricing) Priced per product, in USD, with a currency switcher offering EUR, CHF and GBP. IMPORTANT: on Fax.Plus the '/month' figure on each card is the annual rate. Fax.Plus — Basic $6.99 a month billed as $83.99 annually (200 pages a month, one fax number, one member, $0.10 per extra page, 60 pages maximum per fax); Premium $13.99 / $167.99 (500 pages, $0.07 per extra page, 90 pages per fax, adds toll-free numbers, number porting, CSV log export and the ability to switch off reception); Business $27.99 / $335.99 (1,000 pages); Enterprise $79.99 a month on annual billing, $959.99 a year, and the only card that also shows a monthly-billing rate, 'starts at $99.99' (4,000 pages, multiple fax numbers, unlimited members, $0.03 per extra page, 250 pages per fax, 1,000 AI credits a month, SSO, HIPAA-compliant with BAA, the Fax.Plus API, data residency and Zapier). The banner offers 'up to 3 months free with an annual plan (save up to 22%)'. A free plan gives 10 pages in total, not per month. Extra fax numbers are $4.99 a month (Business and Enterprise include two); vanity numbers $19.99; choosing your own number within a region is a one-time $19.99, or $29.99 from their handpicked memorable set. Porting is free but country-dependent — porting a US or Canadian number requires Premium or higher. The footnotes warn that faxes to certain destinations may count as multiple pages, priced on a separate Sending Rates page, and that taxes are excluded. Sign.Plus is a separate subscription and prints annual and monthly rates side by side: Free (3 signature requests in total, 1 template, 1 user), Personal $9.99 annual / $14.99 monthly, $119.99 a year (1 user, 10 signature requests a month, 5 templates), Professional $19.99 / $29.99 per user, $239.99 a year (up to 5 users, unlimited requests, 10 templates), Business $29.99 / $49.99 per user, $359.99 a year (unlimited templates, document sharing, Zapier, custom branding), Enterprise $49.99 / $79.99 per user, $599.99 a year (SSO, HIPAA-compliant with BAA, advanced security controls, data residency, priority support). Sign.Plus advertises 'save up to 40% with annual plans'. Request via SMS/WhatsApp is metered separately at 10, 30 and 150 a month from Professional upward. The Fax.Plus page's structured product data, read 27 September 2026, also lists monthly-billing prices for the lower tiers that the cards do not print: Basic $8.99, Premium $17.99, Business $34.99 and Enterprise $99.99 a month.
